user.title: Shelly to SDM630 meter translator
user.description: Serves a read-only SDM630 subset. The H3X meter port is RS485, not a TCP meter client: a reverse RTU-to-TCP gateway is required for that port. This integration does not change inverter settings or fix forced charging. Enable Modbus on Shelly first. Only explicitly allowed client IPs/CIDRs can read the listener. Offline sources appear unavailable, never as zero. Connection settings can be changed later.

init.title: Translator network settings
init.description: Changing these settings restarts the translator listener, not Home Assistant. Use a static gateway/client IP. There is no H3X TCP meter-client setting; its RS485 meter port still requires a reverse gateway.
